action.summary: The /health endpoint already exists in server.js (under the "─── Health ──────────────" section). It checks the database connection and returns a JSON response with ok, service, db, and time fields. It returns 200 when the DB responds and 503 when it fails. No changes were needed; if you intended a different behavior (e.g., a simpler liveness check without DB, a different path like /api/health, or additional fields), please clarify.
